description: Discover premium Japanese restaurants with source courses, release rules and honest availability states.

novel_features.name: Course price/fee inspection
novel_features.description: Inspect public course price floors, units, service charges, reservation fee and cancellation caveats.

novel_features.name: Release schedule inspection
novel_features.description: Read source release timing in JST; distinguish scheduled, irregular and undetermined releases from seats.

novel_features.name: Date/party availability boundary
novel_features.description: Inspect a planning date and party with unknown exact seats and query_evaluated false when public access is gated.

novel_features.name: Restaurant comparison
novel_features.description: Compare public terms for two to five restaurant IDs with explicit per-ID failures.

novel_features.name: Local summary inventory
novel_features.description: Explicitly refresh bounded summary pages and inspect or search local inventory coverage.
